entries.name: Stomping Ground Comedy Theater
entries.summary: Nonprofit improv theater and training center in Dallas's Design District offering a five-level class pathway plus musical improv and comedy writing, with weekly house-team shows and free community jams.
entries.schedule: Big Dang Friday (1st/3rd/4th Fri, 7:30pm); Live. Laugh. MURDER + Improvised! The Musical (Sat, 7:30/9pm); The Jam (2nd/3
signals: Nonprofit incorporated May 3, 2017, own venue at 1350 Manufacturing St.
Levels 1-5 plus Advanced Topics, Musical Improv, and Comedy Writing classes
House teams include One Shared Brain Cell and Malicious Compliance
Free public jams: The Jam and The Formula (monthly, for Black performers)
Also runs youth, retiree, neurodiverse, and corporate programs
entries.reasons: A nine-year nonprofit with its own venue, a full beginner-to-advanced class pathway, and a packed weekly show-and-jam calendar, though it has little documented outside press or awards.

entries.name: Four Day Weekend
entries.area: Dallas (also operates a Fort Worth theater)
entries.summary: Long-running improv comedy theater with permanent stages in Dallas and Fort Worth, running weekend house shows alongside a corporate improv-training business and beginner public classes.
entries.schedule: Shows every Friday and Saturday night at both the Dallas and Fort Worth theaters
signals: Over 25 years operating, with its own theaters in two cities
Voted Best Comedy Club and Best Entertainment Experience in Texas
Level 1 public improv classes plus a corporate training center
entries.reasons: Decades of operation, two permanent theaters, and strong press/awards standing, offset by a public class pathway that the live site doesn't detail past "Level 1."
